fights.notes: Same bout as 340. Allen's weight given as about 168 pounds. Opponent named as Gallagher from the context of the other articles; this item says only 'the ring on Tuesday next'.

notes: Hint 1 (Hogan challenge) is about Hogan's own challenge; the Reardon letter in the same column is about Reardon and Hogan and is not recorded as an Allen claim. Hint 2 kept as saloon claims, with the trainer and Saturday date added. 'Last night' taken as 1869-08-13 from a paper dated 1869-08-14.
